description: This method searches for multiple tasks of a specific feed type, and includes date filters and pagination.

parameters.name: feed_type
parameters.description: The feed type associated with the inventory task.

parameters.name: schedule_id
parameters.description: The ID of the schedule for which to retrieve the latest result file.

parameters.name: look_back_days
parameters.description: The number of previous days in which to search for tasks.Default: 7.

parameters.name: date_range
parameters.description: Specifies the range of task creation dates used to filter the results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of tasks that can be returned on each page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of tasks to skip in the result set.
